The user asked on 2026-11-20 to "work on a1+ Unit 5 same all deal as before none stop all approved": A1+ 5.Y follows A1 5.Y with one step each, straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. Five offer photos in Ana's living room: Ana offers Luis tea (yes) and Diego coffee (no), Sofia offers Luis lemonade (yes), Luis offers Sofia hot chocolate (no) and Ana water (no). Photo pack revision 2 replaced o03 (Sofia offering Ana juice), because Sofia and Ana share one voice. Reply cards play the offer and the learner picks the reply that the photo shows. Revised 2026-11-23: every drink is in a clear glass so it can be told apart, and Luis matches his reference photo.

lesson.title: 5.3 Would you like some tea?
lesson.unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
lesson.goal: Offer a drink with Would you like some …? and accept or refuse it (Yes, please. / No, thank you.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.3 Drinks: A1 names drinks and says who drinks them, and A1 5.10 answers an offer with Yes, please. / No, thank you.; A1+ 5.3 makes the offer: Would you like some + a drink? It is one new frame, learnt as a whole (would is not taken apart), with A1+ 4.15's some; hot chocolate and lemonade are the new drinks (lemonade added 2026-11-23). In each photo a host holds out a drink and the guest takes it or holds up a hand, so the photo shows the reply. The asker's voice always differs from the answerer's (Ana and Sofia share one voice, as do Luis and Diego). I'd like waits for 5.9.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 5.3 tea, coffee, water; A1 5.10 Yes, please. / No, thank you.; A1+ 4.15 some; A1 5.5 I like.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say Would you like as one phrase (WOOD-ja-LIKE is fine) with rising intonation at the end of the offer; do not require native-like speed.
